title: Sun, Sky, and River
label: ch:gu-sun-sky-river
canDo: I can hear and say five everyday Gujarati outdoor words, and read and write one of them.

payoff.summary: Five outdoor words enter meaning-first by ear, one lesson each; an oral checkpoint scores listening and speaking apart, river reaches the page with signs taught before chapter 8, and an R1 return carries the chapter-18 face words back at their fourth spacing window.
